message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
  merge_group:

jobs:
  check:
    name: Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        crate:
          - stm32c0
          - stm32f0
          - stm32f1
          - stm32f2
          - stm32f3
          - stm32f4
          - stm32f7
          - stm32h5
          - stm32h7
          - stm32l0
          - stm32l1
          - stm32l4
          - stm32l5
          - stm32g0
          - stm32g4
          - stm32mp1
          - stm32n6
          - stm32u0
          - stm32u5
          - stm32wl
          - stm32wb
          - stm32wb0
          - stm32wba

    env:
      CRATES: ${{ matrix.crate }}
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
      SVDTOOLS: svdtools

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Install xmllint
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install libxml2-utils

      - name: Create working crate
        run: make crates

      - name: Install tools
        run: |
          ./scripts/tool_install.sh svdtools
          ./scripts/tool_install.sh svd2rust

      - name: Patch SVDs
        run: make -j2 patch

      - name: Check SVDs
        run: make lint

      - name: Build PACs
        run: make -j2 svd2rust

      - name: Check PACs
        run: make -j2 check",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs a 24-crate Rust matrix that fetches the Rust toolchain and crate dependencies on every run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (evidence: experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200) measured a 20.4% elapsed-time reduction by adding a dependency cache keyed to lockfiles, with no change to build/test coverage. Prerequisites are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs in every matrix job, and the cache key can include Cargo.lock files plus runner OS. No contraindications apply: there is no existing cache, and the cargo registry/git stores immutable, content-addressed downloads rather than mutable build outputs. The change adds a single cache step after Rust installation and before any cargo invocation, preserving all existing steps, environment variables, matrix coverage, and required checks.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200"]
}
